The same molecule as tembotrione, same atoms and same bonds, differing only in the crystal lattice; it is crystal modification I and not a distinct chemical entity. The section product: [0021] and [0022] obtain it by suspending and/or dissolving modifications II and III, or mixtures of them, in a suitable solvent and treating at 0 to 80 degrees C until quantitative conversion. [0026] gives a second, solvent-free route to the same modification, grinding modifications II and III under high pressure, a pressure of at least 5 bar. Impfkristalle der Kristallmodifikation I in [0024] are seed crystals of this same modification, so they are folded in as an alias rather than emitted as a separate substance. commercially_available false because this document prepares it.
